name: ShopCentral – Advanced Multi Store Management & Store Analytics for WooCommerce
author: Dominopress

sections.description:
ShopCentral is the ultimate, streamlined WooCommerce Multi-Store Manager and Analytics Suite. Designed specifically for ambitious store owners, agencies, and high-volume merchants, ShopCentral replaces the standard, often cluttered WordPress admin view with a lightning-fast, modern dashboard.

If you are managing multiple WooCommerce stores, you know the struggle of logging in and out of different websites, juggling numerous tabs, and trying to keep stock, orders, and customer data synchronized. ShopCentral gives you the unified “Command Center” you need to take full control of your e-commerce business.

🌐 Official Resources & Quick Links

  • Official Website & Product Tour
  • All 23+ Features Catalog
  • Official Documentation & Setup Guides
  • Video Tutorials & Demos
  • Pro Pricing & Upgrade Plans

💡 Why Do You Need ShopCentral? (Use Cases & Examples)

  • The Scaling Merchant: Example: You own a successful WooCommerce store selling apparel and decide to launch a separate B2B wholesale store. Without ShopCentral, you’d have to manage two separate inventories, manually track orders across two dashboards, and update products twice. With ShopCentral, you connect both stores to one hub. When a product sells on the retail site, inventory is automatically synced and reduced on the B2B site.
  • The Agency Managing Client Stores: Example: You run an agency managing 10 different WooCommerce stores for various clients. Monitoring their performance, running exports for monthly reports, and keeping an eye on order fulfillment is a nightmare. ShopCentral allows you to connect all 10 client stores into one centralized dashboard. You can instantly generate cross-store PDF reports, check overall revenue, and monitor order statuses without needing 10 different logins.
  • The Multi-Region Brand: Example: You sell globally and have separate WooCommerce installations for the US, UK, and EU to handle different currencies and shipping rules. ShopCentral acts as your global headquarters. You can deploy a new product to all three regions simultaneously using the Smart Product Creator, apply global price adjustments in bulk, and aggregate your worldwide sales data into a single, unified analytics view.

🎥 Video Tutorials

ShopCentral Setup & Overview:

ShopCentral Feature Guides (Playlist): Watch the Full Tutorial Playlist on YouTube

🏬 Centralized WooCommerce Dashboard Benefits

Managing a growing e-commerce business is challenging. As your store scales—or as you add more stores to your portfolio—keeping track of orders, products, and customer behavior becomes incredibly time-consuming. ShopCentral solves this by aggregating your crucial business data into a single, high-performance interface.

  • Save Hours of Time: Manage all your stores from one centralized login. No more jumping between different WordPress admin panels.
  • Make Data-Driven Decisions: Instantly see which products are performing best and track your revenue trends across all your sites.
  • Improve Operational Efficiency: Process orders, update stock, and analyze customer behavior at blazing fast speeds.
  • Scale Without Limits: Built to handle high-volume data without bloating your main site’s database, thanks to our smart remote proxy architecture.

📋 Comprehensive Menu & Feature Breakdown

ShopCentral is organized into powerful, purpose-built modules. Here is exactly what you can do from each menu in your command center:

📊 Dashboard

Your executive summary and real-time business monitor.
* Total Network Revenue & Orders: View aggregated metrics across all your connected shops. Example: See at a glance that your US and UK stores combined generated $15,000 today.
* Top-Selling Products: Identifies which products are driving the most volume globally. Explanation: Helps you quickly reorder stock for items that are suddenly trending across multiple regions.

🏪 Stores

The control room for your multi-store network.
* Unlimited Store Connections: Connect WooCommerce sites securely via REST API keys. Explanation: Allows you to scale your business without dashboard limitations.
* Order & Customer Sync Toggles: Enable or disable background syncing on a per-store basis. Example: You might want to sync orders from your retail store but keep your wholesale B2B store data isolated.
* Smart Firewall Bypass Config: Step-by-step UI to whitelist ShopCentral in strict firewalls like Cloudflare WAF. Explanation: Ensures your stores can communicate seamlessly without getting blocked by security rules.

📦 Products

Your unified product catalog and inventory watchtower.

  • Global Stock Overview: Monitor stock quantities across all sites simultaneously. Example: Instantly spot if a popular t-shirt is “Out of Stock” on your US store but still available on your EU store.
  • Bidirectional Inventory Sync: Stock is automatically adjusted everywhere. Explanation: When a product sells on Store A, the stock is instantly reduced on Store B, preventing costly overselling.
  • Product Type Filtering: Quickly filter catalog by Simple or Variable products to streamline bulk updates.

🛒 Orders

A powerful, centralized timeline of all sales across your business.
* Cross-Store Order Timeline: See orders coming in chronologically from every connected store. Example: Watch a live feed where an order from Store A is immediately followed by an order from Store B.
* Full Order Import: Child site orders are mirrored perfectly on the central hub, including line items, metadata, and ACF fields. Explanation: Makes your hub site fully compatible with accounting integrations like Xero or QuickBooks.

🏷️ Discounts

Centralized view for promotional campaigns.
* Global Discount Tracking: View all active coupons from all stores in one place. Example: Quickly check if the “SUMMER24” code is still active on your secondary site without logging in there.

👥 Customers

Unified CRM and user management.
* Network-Wide Customer Base: See every buyer across all platforms. Explanation: Tracks total spend and order counts per customer, so you know exactly who your biggest VIPs are globally.
* Customer Sync by Email: Automatically matches child store orders to existing hub site users via email, keeping your customer data clean and deduplicated.

🎟️ Global Coupon

Network-wide promotional distribution.

  • Simultaneous Coupon Creation: Distribute a discount code to all your stores at once. Example: You want to run a Black Friday sale—instead of logging into 5 different stores to create the “BF50” coupon, you create it once here and it broadcasts to all 5 stores instantly.

🧠 Customer Insight

Advanced analytics for buyer behavior.
* Audience Segmentation: Identify your most valuable buyers based on purchase history. Example: Filter for customers who have spent over $1,000 across any of your stores, and export their emails for a VIP newsletter.

⚙️ Automation

Multi-store workflow engine.
* Rule-Based Triggers: Automate repetitive tasks across your network. Example: Set up a workflow that automatically tags a customer as “Wholesale” if they purchase a specific bulk product from any connected store.

📈 Store Analytics

Macro-level business intelligence.
* Revenue Trend Comparison: Compare performance side-by-side. Example: View a graph showing that your EU store’s revenue is growing 20% faster than your US store this quarter, allowing you to reallocate marketing budget effectively.

🔍 Product Analytics

Micro-level sales intelligence.
* Variation & Region Tracking: Dive deep into specific product metrics. Example: Discover that the “Blue / Large” variation of your jacket sells incredibly well in the UK, but poorly in the US.

📥 Export Tools

Comprehensive data extraction suite.

  • Time-Period Filtering: Export Products, Orders, Reviews, Customers, and Coupons to CSV. Example: At the end of the month, export all orders from “This Month” across all stores into a single CSV for your accountant.
  • Centralized PDF Reports: Generate clean, invoice-style PDF summaries for stakeholders in one click.

🖌️ Global Product Editor

Centralized catalog management.

  • Direct Hub Editing: Edit existing remote products directly from your main dashboard. Explanation: Manage pricing, update descriptions, and upload new media to child stores without leaving the hub. Features a full variations table for variable products.
  • Custom Meta & ACF Sync: Automatically synchronizes custom fields and metadata alongside standard product data.

⚡ Smart Product Creator

Revolutionary cross-store deployment.

  • 3-Step Wizard: Create simple or variable products across multiple stores simultaneously. Example: Launch a new product line to 10 stores at once, complete with categories, tags, images, and variation pricing.
  • Per-Store Price Adjustments: Automatically increase prices by 10% when deploying to a specific region to account for shipping/taxes.

📋 ShopCentral Logs

Centralized debugging and activity tracking.
* Filtered Activity Viewer: Spot API connection issues or sync errors instantly. Example: If a product fails to sync to one specific store, the log will tell you exactly why (e.g., “SKU already exists”), saving hours of troubleshooting.

🛠️ System Tools

Under-the-hood performance management.
* Manual Triggers & Cache Management: Force manual order syncs, clear plugin caches, and tweak performance settings to ensure your hub site remains lightning fast under heavy load.

🚀 Comprehensive Feature Breakdown (By Category)

Explore the 23 core modules that power your centralized multi-store network:

1. 🏪 Store Control (Multi-Store Command Center)

  • Manage Multiple WooCommerce Stores: Connect external WooCommerce child stores securely to your central Hub via REST API keys.
  • One Click Store Switch: Instantly switch context between connected stores with zero latency and full dashboard preservation.
  • Store Notification Alert System: Real-time alerts for critical events, low inventory thresholds, and remote store connectivity status.
  • ShopCentral Logs & Activity Audit: Comprehensive activity audit stream of background sync queues, severity filtering, and JSON error inspector.
  • Premium Store Dashboard: Executive summary of multi-store network performance with aggregated KPI cards (Total Stores, Active Channels, Auto-Sync Status).

2. ⚡ Automated Sync Engine (Stock & Variations)

  • Real-Time Stock Sync: Automatic network-wide stock adjustment. When an item is sold on any store, inventory decreases everywhere instantly.
  • Variable Product & Variation Sync: Comprehensive support for simple and variable products, SKU-based variations, size/color attributes, and variation-level stock.
  • Inventory Sync Engine & Live Monitor: Advanced inventory engine with real-time live activity monitor, selective exclusions (by category, tag, or product), and low-stock safety buffers.

3. 📦 Central Product Creator & Push Engine

  • One Click Push Products: Instantly push newly created products or broadcast updates across all connected child stores with a single click.
  • Smart Product Creator: 3-step wizard to create simple or variable products and publish them selectively or network-wide with custom regional price rules.
  • Custom Meta & ACF Repeater Sync: Synchronize product metadata and Advanced Custom Fields (ACF), including repeater fields, without data loss.
  • Single & Variable Product Editor: Full product editing suite with 1-click instant restock buttons (+10, +25, +50), variation matrix management, and bulk restocking.

4. 🏷️ Pricing, Bulk Actions & Automation

  • One Click Price Updates: Bulk update regular and sale prices across connected stores by percentage or fixed amount in seconds.
  • Global Product Editor: Perform powerful bulk actions (bulk price adjustments, descriptions, categories) across multiple stores simultaneously.
  • Powerful Automation: Multi-store workflow automation rules for abandoned carts, post-purchase follow-ups, and customer tagging.
  • Global Coupon: Create and distribute promotional coupon codes across all connected child stores in one operation.

5. 🛒 Order Management & Fulfillment

  • Order Import & Sync: Import orders from child stores into your central Hub using Action Scheduler queues. Compatible with Xero, QuickBooks, and warehouse software.
  • Central Customer Order History: Consolidated customer profile view revealing total lifetime spend, orders, and buying behavior across all stores.
  • Customer Intelligence & Segmentation: Automatic RFM segmentation grouping customers into VIP, Loyal, At-Risk, New, and Churned segments.
  • Bulk Order Status & Courier Tracking: Batch update order statuses across unlimited stores, attach courier tracking codes, and dispatch customer notes in 1 click.

6. 📊 Network Analytics & Data Export

  • Products Analytics: Granular analytics identifying top-performing bestsellers, slow movers, and dead stock across your multi-store network.
  • Store Analytics: High-level macro analytics comparing revenue trends and sales channel growth side-by-side.
  • Central Data Export Tools & PDF Reports: Export Products, Orders, Customers, and Coupons to CSV, or generate branded, invoice-style PDF performance reports.

🛡️ Smart Firewall Bypass & Security

ShopCentral connects your Hub site to your child stores directly via encrypted REST API calls.
* No Third-Party Middleman: Your customer, product, and financial data is never sent to or stored on external proprietary cloud servers.
* Cloudflare & WAF Integration: Outbound requests use unique cryptographic shared_secret headers (X-ShopCentral-Secret) and custom user agents to seamlessly bypass strict firewall rules without requiring static IP whitelisting.

💎 Free vs. Pro Store Limits

  • Free Version: Connect up to 2 Stores (1 Primary Hub + 1 Remote Child Store) with essential multi-store management, stock sync, and centralized dashboard tools.
  • Pro Plans (Personal, Professional, Business/Unlimited): Unlock 3 to unlimited store connections, automated order imports, ACF repeater sync, advanced RFM customer intelligence, and priority support.
  • 👉 View Pro Plans & Pricing
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin files to the /wp-content/plugins/shopcentral directory, or install the plugin through the WordPress plugins screen directly.
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ screen in WordPress.
  3. Navigate to the ShopCentral menu in your WordPress admin dashboard.
  4. Your current site is automatically configured as the Primary Hub.
  5. To connect an external store, generate REST API keys on your child store (WooCommerce > Settings > Advanced > REST API) with Read/Write permissions.
  6. Click Add Store in the ShopCentral dashboard and enter the external store URL, Consumer Key, and Consumer Secret.
  7. Switch between active and connected stores to manage them using the store selector in the top navigation bar.
sections.faq:
How do I sync orders across multiple WooCommerce stores?

ShopCentral automatically imports orders from your child stores to your main “Hub” site via the REST API and background Action Scheduler queues. You can seamlessly sync order metadata, ACF fields, and line items across multiple WooCommerce shops without manual export/import.

Can I manage multiple WooCommerce shops from one dashboard?

Yes! ShopCentral is explicitly built to let you manage multiple WooCommerce stores from a single, centralized dashboard. You can switch between active stores, track revenue, handle orders, and push products network-wide without logging into different admin panels.

Does ShopCentral support bidirectional automatic inventory sync?

Yes. Our advanced inventory sync feature automatically reduces stock across your entire network of connected stores whenever a sale occurs on any site, ensuring 100% accurate stock levels and preventing overselling.

Is my store data sent to a third-party server?

No. ShopCentral connects your “Command Center” WordPress site directly to your other WooCommerce stores using the WooCommerce REST API. Your store data is not stored on any third-party servers.

Does it sync all orders to my main database by default?

By default, ShopCentral acts as a remote proxy viewer to preserve performance, preventing massive database bloat. You can optionally enable full Order Sync on a per-store basis to physically import child site orders into your hub site’s database.

Is it compatible with High-Performance Order Storage (HPOS)?

Yes, ShopCentral is 100% compatible with WooCommerce HPOS (formerly Custom Order Tables).

Where can I find detailed documentation and video guides?

You can explore full step-by-step documentation at https://dominopress.com/docs/shopcentral-pro and watch video guides at https://dominopress.com/shopcentral/videos.

3.0.2

  • Fix: High-Performance Direct SQL Analytics – Replaced memory-heavy wc_get_orders() object hydration across order metrics, stats, product analytics, and sales report with lightweight direct SQL aggregation, completely eliminating 512MB PHP memory exhaustion errors on stores with thousands of orders.
  • Fix: HPOS Sales & Trend Reports – Resolved database error (Unknown column 'o.shipping_amount' in 'SELECT') by properly joining wp_wc_order_operational_data for shipping and discount totals in High-Performance Order Storage mode.
  • Fix: Restored “Sales & Order Trends” area chart rendering and daily order volume distribution for local hub and multi-store views.
  • Fix: Currency Symbol Encoding – Resolved issue where currency symbols like Hungarian Forint (HUF) displayed raw HTML entities (Ft) instead of clean UTF-8 text (Ft) across dashboard cards and analytics tables.
  • Fix: Prevented inventory sync loop and duplicate stock reduction spikes caused by recursive webhook events during background order processing.
  • Improvement: Added micro-caching and memory ceiling safeguards (wp_raise_memory_limit) across all analytical endpoints for blazing-fast response times (<10ms).
  • Improvement: Frontend currency formatters now automatically decode HTML entity representations using browser DOM parsing.

3.0.1

  • Fix: Fixed an issue where the free version “Add Store” button incorrectly displayed “Upgrade to Add Store” when 1 primary hub store was present, preventing users from connecting their allowed 2nd store.
  • Improvement: Connected stores limit checking now dynamically uses the configured store limit from the backend.

  • New: Added Selective Sync & category/tag/product exclusions, Low-Stock Safety Buffer & Threshold, and Cross-Store Dynamic Pricing Engine in Inventory Sync.
  • New: Added Cross-Store Dead Stock & Slow Mover Analytics.
  • New: Added separate Inventory Sync menu with real-time Live Sync Activity Monitor.
  • New: Added Live Sync Activity Monitor bulk selection, dedicated Bulk Delete button, and single row trash delete actions.
  • Improvement: Global Price Update Modal – Replaced dropdown with distinct checkboxes for “Regular Price” and “Sale Price”, allowing flexible single or simultaneous updates across connected stores.
  • Improvement: Global Price Update Modal – Streamlined interface and backend by removing the category filter for lightning-fast network-wide bulk price updates.
  • Fix: Variable Product Order Import – Mapped child variation SKUs to native Hub variation IDs, resolving WooCommerce WC_Data_Exception and preventing missing order items during remote order import.
  • Fix: Variable Product Catalog Synchronization – Fixed synchronization when variations are removed or updated on the primary hub, preventing duplicate or phantom variations on child stores.
  • Fix: Stock Minimum Limit Buffer – Ensured child store stock is immediately set to 0 (Out of Stock) when Hub inventory reaches or drops below the configured stock buffer threshold.
  • Improvement: First-Time Store Activation Defaults – Settings default to disabled in the database until explicitly confirmed by the store manager.

2.8.0

  • Fix: Automatic synchronization issue for variable products between parent and child stores.
  • Fix: Bug where the manual “Push” function duplicated product variations with the same SKU.
  • Fix: Recurring “synchronization failed” errors during product push operations.

🛡️ Smart Firewall Bypass & Security

ShopCentral connects your Hub site to your child stores directly via encrypted REST API calls.
* No Third-Party Middleman: Your customer, product, and financial data is never sent to or stored on external proprietary cloud servers.
* Cloudflare & WAF Integration: Outbound requests use unique cryptographic shared_secret headers (X-ShopCentral-Secret) and custom user agents to seamlessly bypass strict firewall rules without requiring static IP whitelisting.
